Figure 1 : RePlan-VLA: Execution-aware replanning for long-horizon robotic manipulation. Given a long-horizon language instruction and scene observations, RePlan-VLA decomposes the task into executable short-horizon subtasks, monitors the robot’s progress and detects discrepancies between intended and observed outcomes.
In this real-world rollout, the robot initially fails to place the white block into the bowl.
RePlan-VLA identifies the incomplete manipulation and replans to retry the failed subtask before proceeding with the remaining objectives.
